description: Unit test for the LongValueValidator class, testing validation logic for long values in header definitions.

classes.name: LongValueValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for LongValueValidator, verifying long value validation logic, immutability, and null handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mock HeaderDefinition and the LongValueValidator instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the LongValueValidator class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Verifies that passing null as header definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that null value input throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateLong
methods.description: Checks that the validator correctly reports it can validate Java long types.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Confirms that a valid long string is accepted without exceptions.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotLong
methods.description: Verifies that validation doesn't occur if the header's Java type isn't Long.

methods.name: acceptInvalidCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid long string triggers the appropriate exception.
